package com.acme.auth

import io.kotest.core.spec.style.StringSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.longs.shouldBeBetween
import io.kotest.matchers.nulls.shouldNotBeNull
import java.time.Instant

class SessionIssuerSpec : StringSpec({
    "issued token carries an expiry about an hour out" {
        val before = Instant.now()
        val token = SessionIssuer(ttlSeconds = 3600).issue(userId = "u-1")
        val after = Instant.now()

        token.expiresAt.shouldNotBeNull()
        token.expiresAt.epochSecond.shouldBeBetween(
            before.plusSeconds(3600).epochSecond - 5,
            after.plusSeconds(3600).epochSecond + 5,
        )
    }
})

package com.acme.github

import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory

class GitHubRepositorySpec : FunSpec({
    val api = Retrofit.Builder()
        .baseUrl("https://api.github.com/")
        .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
        .build()
        .create(GitHubService::class.java)
    val repository = GitHubRepository(api)

    test("loads the kotlin repo") {
        val repo = repository.fetchRepo("JetBrains", "kotlin")
        repo.fullName shouldBe "JetBrains/kotlin"
    }
})
